test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 19 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Two successive discounts of 20% and 25% on the marked price of an article are equal to a single discount of Rs. 250. If the marked price of the article is 25% above the cost price, the cost price (in Rs.) of the article is:
solution:
Formula Used:

Effective discount = d1 + d2 - d₁ × d₂ over 100

Where “d1” and “d2” are successive discounts offered.

**Calculation:**

Effective discount = 20 + 25 - 20 × 25 over 100 = 40%

⇒ 40% discount on MP = Rs 250

MP = 250 over 40 × 100 = Rs 625

MP is 25% above the CP i.e., Cost Price

⇒ CP = 625 over 125 × 100 = Rs 500.

∴ **The cost price of the article is Rs 500.**
